context: Checks whether the final artifact follows the review-prd instructions from the published agnostic-planning-skills plugin.

checklist.name: instruction-1
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: EVERY finding MUST cite the specific PRD section, line, or requirement — if the cited text contains sensitive data (API keys, tokens, passwords, credentials), abstract or redact it rather than reproducing it verbatim.

checklist.name: instruction-2
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Scan the checklist** (see [Review Checklist](#review-checklist) below) — covers completeness, testability, clarity, feasibility, scope, dependencies, and edge cases.

checklist.name: instruction-3
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Classify:** Critical (blocks implementation), Suggestion (improves it), Note (observation).

checklist.name: instruction-4
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Produce** — findings table with severity, evidence, and recommendation.

checklist.name: instruction-5
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: [ ] No ambiguous modal verbs ("should" vs. "must" vs. "may").
